sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
items.blurb: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.

items.title: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions, a new serverless compute primitive where your code handles HTTP requests directly. Your code listens on a port and handles requests as it would on any HTTP server.

items.title: Muse Spark Open model now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: Meta's Muse Spark Open is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization now available in AWS GovCloud and additional commercial Regions
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) and 13 additional commercial Regions.

items.title: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) and AWS GovCloud (US-East) Regions.

items.title: AWS Will Run Its European Sovereign Cloud Without the Global Backbone for Several Hours
items.blurb: On October 24, AWS will operate its European Sovereign Cloud without a connection to the AWS Global Network backbone, with a team of EU residents and the region’s own hardware and software.

items.title: Amazon Acquires DuckLabs and Integrates DuckDB in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
items.blurb: Amazon has acquired DuckLabs, the company behind the analytical database DuckDB. Co-founders Hannes Mühleisen and Mark Raasveldt will continue to lead the team under AWS.

items.title: AWS Introduces Strands Decider 2B and Strands Box for AI Agent Development
items.blurb: AWS has introduced two open-source projects for AI agent development: Strands Decider 2B, a small model designed to make decisions within agent workflows, and Strands Box, a sandbox for controlling agent execution.
